item_title: Google changes its appeals process for CSAM-flagged accounts; content deemed exploitative will still be removed and reported but users can plead their innocence
item_description: Kashmir Hill / New York Times:  — People who upload images of children that Google flags as potentially illegal will be able to provide more context to appeal bans.

item_title: Tim Wu, who helped shape Joe Biden's antitrust agenda, plans to leave his adviser role on January 4 and return to teaching antitrust law at Columbia Law School
item_description: Emily Birnbaum / Bloomberg:  — Adviser Tim Wu, who helped to shape President Joe Biden's antitrust agenda, will leave his position Jan. 4, the White House said Friday.
